gate_contracts.outcome: build artifacts or source code exist and are non-empty
build report documents what was implemented
test execution report exists with structured results (tests_run, passed, failed counts)
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Semantic judgment required: do the test results demonstrate adequate coverage? The structural check verifies that tests were executed and results recorded in structured format, not just that test files exist.

gate_contracts.outcome: security testing evidence recorded or applicability justification documented
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Semantic judgment required: does the security evidence demonstrate adequate coverage for the project's threat surface? The structural check verifies that security-testing was applied and recorded; only human review can assess whether the security assessment is sufficient for the project's risk profile.

gate_contracts.outcome: quality audit verdict recorded as a structured sidecar: verdict pass, zero unresolved blocking findings, prose verdict agrees
quality audit report references specific file locations as evidence
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Semantic judgment required: do the cited locations correspond to meaningful review points? The structural check verifies the review engaged with specific code rather than producing a generic verdict.

gate_contracts.outcome: quality audit report includes a structured findings or recommendations section
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Semantic judgment required: are the findings substantive and actionable? The structural check verifies the review produced documented findings rather than only a verdict.

gate_contracts.outcome: quality audit has a signed receipt chained to the test execution receipt, proving separate executions
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Semantic judgment required: was the quality audit substantive and independent in judgment? The structural check verifies via cryptographic receipt chaining that two separate signed execution events occurred — the test execution and the quality audit — with the audit referencing the test receipt. This replaces self-declared author_agent identity with verifiable execution separation.

gate_contracts.outcome: test execution report has cryptographic fingerprint verifying content integrity
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Semantic judgment required: does the fingerprint correspond to actual tool execution? The structural check verifies the report was not tampered with after creation; only process verification can confirm the tool actually ran.

gate_contracts.outcome: test execution report cross-references actual test files in the project
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Semantic judgment required: do the cross-referenced files correspond to the tests that were actually executed? The structural check verifies the referenced files exist in the project.

gate_contracts.outcome: test execution has a trusted receipt proving the tool actually ran
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Semantic judgment required: does the test execution cover adequate scenarios? The structural check verifies the test runner was actually executed via the trusted runner with a valid signed receipt. Without this receipt, the gate fails closed — fabricated test results cannot pass.

gate_contracts.outcome: build report has a methodology section listing applied steps with evidence per step
gate_contracts.check: node scripts/gate-check.mjs domain-coverage prime/reports/phase-5-build.md contracts/coverage/phase-5-build.json methodology-checklist

gate_contracts.outcome: Source code adopts design tokens (colors/typography/spacing); visual parity with the Phase 3 design language is confirmed in Phase 6 verification
gate_contracts.manual_followup: The check verifies the delivered source actually uses design tokens (CSS custom properties / theme config / oklch|hsl scale) rather than generic hardcoded defaults. Semantic judgment still required: does the rendered UI visually match the Phase 3 design language — spacing rhythm, type scale, component states? Confirm in Phase 6 with screenshots. N/A for projects with no UI.

gate_contracts.outcome: security testing report names concrete security patterns in a dedicated section and records what was done about each
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Verify the security testing report records specific security patterns actually implemented, not just 'security was considered'. The vocabulary should match patterns from SECURITY-AUDIT.md reference. Generic statements indicate the reference was not loaded.

gate_contracts.outcome: build report cites the Phase 3 design document as the implementation's design source in a dedicated section
gate_contracts.check: node scripts/gate-check.mjs domain-coverage prime/reports/phase-5-build.md contracts/coverage/phase-5-build.json design-system-reference
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Confirm the build report explicitly references docs/DESIGN.canvas.tsx (or the project's design document) as the design source, demonstrating traceability from design to implementation. Generic statements like 'followed the design' without citing the document indicate the reference was not loaded. N/A for projects with no UI.

gate_contracts.outcome: source code contains no unfinished-content markers (lorem ipsum / under construction / coming soon)
gate_contracts.manual_followup: The scan greps delivered source for unambiguous unfinished-content tells. It intentionally ignores bare TODO/FIXME (legitimate tracked debt) and placeholder= attributes; the reviewer judges whether any remaining stub is acceptable for this deliverable.

gate_contracts.manual_followup: Confirm the build report addresses specific responsive breakpoints, performance targets, and SEO metadata — not just generic mentions. N/A for non-website UI (dashboards, internal tools).

gate_contracts.outcome: delivered source contains no high-confidence hardcoded secrets
gate_contracts.manual_followup: The scan greps delivered source for narrow, high-confidence credential patterns (AWS/GitHub/Google/Slack tokens, PEM private-key headers, long literals assigned to key/secret/token/password) and never prints the matched value. Reviewer triages the reported file:line hits; test fixtures and *.example files are skipped.

gate_contracts.outcome: build report describes its error-handling strategy in a dedicated section (report-attested; scan-empty-catch remains the code oracle)
gate_contracts.check: node scripts/gate-check.mjs domain-coverage prime/reports/phase-5-build.md contracts/coverage/phase-5-build.json error-handling-strategy
gate_contracts.manual_followup: This gate reads the report, not the code — it is ADVISORY and must not be described as verified. Reviewer confirms there are no empty catch blocks that hide failures; `node scripts/gate-check.mjs scan-empty-catch .` is available as a diagnostic (many intentional empty catches are legitimate, so it is not a hard gate).

gate_contracts.outcome: build report documents structured logging or error-tracking usage in a dedicated section
gate_contracts.check: node scripts/gate-check.mjs domain-coverage prime/reports/phase-5-build.md contracts/coverage/phase-5-build.json structured-logging
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Verify error handling uses structured logging or error tracking services, not just console.error/console.log. N/A for CLI tools or scripts where console output is appropriate. This gate checks report text only — it does not scan source files directly.

gate_contracts.outcome: output intent JSON records output type, audience, quality bar, verification method, and evidence artifacts
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Confirm the output intent JSON has specific, measurable quality criteria - not vague goals like 'make it fast' or 'good UX'. The structural check verifies the JSON exists with required fields; gate-check.mjs quality-intent validator enforces field content.

gate_contracts.outcome: high-impact UI build intent includes a traceable Design Benchmark Record with external sources, adopted patterns, local decisions, and rejected ideas when applicable
gate_contracts.manual_followup: Confirm the benchmark sources and adopted patterns are relevant to the actual UI being built. The structural check rejects missing, vague, one-source, and Mobbin MCP-based records.

gate_contracts.outcome: test results verified by actual execution
gate_contracts.enforcement_purpose: Re-executes every test file referenced in the test results JSON and compares claimed pass/fail counts against actual exit codes. GATE-PASS only if all pass AND counts match. GATE-FAIL with claimed-vs-actual diff if mismatch. Partial result when test files cannot be executed due to infrastructure constraints.

gate_contracts.outcome: delivered code compiles/typechecks/lints cleanly, or the project defines no build step
gate_contracts.enforcement_purpose: Directly executes the project's real compile/typecheck/lint step (tsc --noEmit when typescript+tsconfig are present, else a package.json build/check/lint/typecheck script, else cargo check / go build) and gates on its exit code. Emits BUILD-NA and passes when the project defines no such step, so script-only projects are not blocked. This is the RUNNABLE replacement for the old 'a source file merely exists' bar.

gate_contracts.outcome: delivered UI source is bound to a registered proven base system, or records an explicit user-approved bespoke design
gate_contracts.enforcement_purpose: The base-system law was only graded in Phase 3, which the focused and product_increment shapes skip, so small UI changes shipped invented palettes and unadapted layouts. This gate proves the law from delivered source instead: the tree must name a registered baseSystem (canvas, theme/tokens config, or a base-system comment) and reproduce at least 50% of that entry's published token hex values, which defeats laundering an invented palette under a registered id, and its styling source must carry width breakpoints at each numeric responsive_contract band boundary using mobile-first min-width queries, which defeats a registered id attached to a single fixed layout. Emits BASE-SYSTEM-NA when no styling source exists, so non-UI work is never blocked; a recorded custom_approval quote passes without registry binding.
